item.title: Little Butt and Big Butt - 6.3 Mi, 1700 Ft EG — Mon Sep 28, 8:00 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group **Description** Another higher elevation hike with a fun name and maybe we will see some fall colors. This is on out and back for a total of 6.3 miles and 1700 ft of elevation gain. In the section from Little Butt to Point Misery Gap there are reportedly 365 wooden steps so be prepared for a leg workout. Some sections of the trail may be a bit overgrown so I suggest long pants and it sounds like it will be cold enough that you may want them and a jacket too.
https://www.alltrails.com/explore/trail/us/north-carolina/big-butt-trail
**CARPOOL** Meet at the Folk Art Center on the BRP at 8am. If you want to go directly to the trailhead, please let me know and use the directions in AllTrails. We will start at the Walker Knob Overlook at about 8:45 am unless we get stuck behind the gravel trucks again.

Intention: The Long Thread We carry more than we know: stories, wounds, wisdom, love, habits, hopes, and the traces of those who came before us. On this night, we’ll honor our ancestors and the long line that brought us here, feeling the thread of life moving through us. And we’ll turn toward the future: what do we want to carry forward, and what do we want to leave behind?

item.title: Lea and Heffernan of Wheelchair Sports Camp — Fri Oct 9, 3:00 PM
item.description:
Gaelynn Lea and Kalyn Rose Heffernan of Wheelchair Sports Camp will visit UNC Asheville for an afternoon talk and evening performance. At 3 p.m., Lea and Heffernan will discuss disability culture, access, and activism, sharing their experiences as artists and advocates working to make the arts more inclusive. At 6 p.m., Wheelchair Sports Camp will take the stage for a free performance. Lea, winner of NPR Music’s Tiny Desk Contest, is an accomplished violinist, songwriter, composer, and disability advocate who has performed around the world and composed the score for Macbeth on Broadway. Wheelchair Sports Camp, led by wheelchair-using rapper Kalyn Rose Heffernan, blends hip-hop, humor, and high-energy performance. The Denver-based band has expanded its work beyond music into performance art, museums, theater, film, and activism. Both events are free and open to the public and will take place in the Blue Ridge Room of the Highsmith Student Union.

item.title: A Night of Swing Dancing - Beginners Welcome! — Fri Oct 9, 7:00 PM
item.description:
Asheville 20s-40s Social Group Want to try something a little different on a Friday night?
Come learn to swing dance at Asheville Swing Night! Swing dancing has its roots in the jazz and swing era of the 1920s–40s, and there's something pretty fun about learning the same dances people were doing nearly a century ago.
It's upbeat, social, and playful, with plenty of partner changes, spins, and opportunities to meet new people.
And you absolutely do **not** need to know what you're doing before you arrive!
The night starts at 7PM with a beginner lesson designed for people who are brand new to swing dancing. You'll learn the basic footwork and a few moves to get you out on the dance floor.
Most people rotate partners during the lesson, so there's no need to bring one, and plenty of people come alone.
Then at 8PM, the lesson wraps up and the DJ takes over for two hours of social dancing. 🎶

item.title: Weekly Critique — Wed Oct 14, 6:00 PM
item.description:
AVL Writers This is the standing weekly critique. Bring anything new you're working on to share with the group. If you don't have a project to share, you are most welcome to attend, discuss, and get inspired.
For our group discussion, please bring at least 8-10 printed copies of your piece. That way, we can all read through each other's work and provide feedback.
Sharing our creative efforts is an important part of the writing process. I'm really looking forward to reading what you've been working on. Don't worry if it's still a rough draft.
If you're having trouble finding us, look for a placard on the table with the group's name.
If you would like to join our group email list for updates regarding contests, events, and more [you can sign up on our website](https://avlwriters.com/).
